systems.name: FlareCore
systems.description: The pure-Swift engine of a Mac-native 2D vector animation studio: document model, commands with undo, timeline, easing, file format and export. Linux-safe, Foundation only. The Mac app lives in another repo.

containers.name: FlareCore library
containers.description: The FlareCore Swift package (Sources/FlareCore). Value types only, Codable and Sendable, and nothing crashes on untrusted input.

components.name: Document and Command Engine
components.description: The document model (Document > Scene > Layer > Shape, keyframe tracks, fills, metadata, frame labels), the Command protocol and CommandEngine with exact undo/redo, groups, coalescing and an undo depth limit, the CommandRegistry that decodes any command from a JSON envelope, the built-in command families, and the .flare v1 file format with validation. Every document change goes through a Command.

components.name: Geometry
components.description: 2D affine Matrix, the Transform (position, scale, rotation) layers and instances use, axis-aligned Rect, vector Paths with line, quadratic and cubic segments, and tight shape bounds. Never returns non-finite values.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Frame/time conversion, keyframe interpolation with binary-search segment lookup, easing curves (linear, cubic bezier, hold), and sampling a layer's property values at a frame for rendering and export.

components.name: Export
components.description: Exporters that turn a scene into other formats: one frame as an SVG document, and a scene as a Lottie JSON document with animated position and easing. Output is byte-stable and throws on non-finite values.

components.name: Symbols
components.description: Reusable symbol definitions and their instances on layers: how an instance maps the host timeline onto the symbol's own timeline, the add/remove/convert-to-symbol commands, and the check that rejects symbols that contain themselves.

components.name: State Machine
components.description: Interactive state machines: states that play a frame range of a scene, transitions fired by named triggers, and typed bool/number inputs with transition conditions.

containers.name: CoreColor library
containers.description: Shared color module (Sources/CoreColor): color spaces and conversions for every app. Linux-safe, Foundation only, no dependencies.

containers.name: CoreRaster library
containers.description: Shared raster module (Sources/CoreRaster): pixel buffers, compositing and image operations for Photo, Library and Halo. Linux-safe, Foundation only.
